lead.title: Checklist: 10 processes to automate
lead.text: A practical guide to find where AI automation pays off first in your company.
lead.consent: I agree to be contacted by DevloperEU about this topic.
lead.thanks: Checklist downloaded. Want to apply it to your business?
lead.docIntro: Tick every process that exists in your company. The more you tick, the greater the automation potential.
items: Answering the same customer questions by email, chat or phone
Logging contacts and requests in spreadsheets by hand
Qualifying and answering new leads outside office hours
Sending reminders, confirmations or invoices manually
Copying data from one system to another
Compiling weekly or monthly reports from several sources
Triaging and routing internal requests (support, purchasing, HR)
Tracking proposals and following up with customers
Extracting information from documents, emails or forms
Monitoring indicators and alerting the team when something is off
